session_summary: A medical session discussing Mrs. Georgescu's diabetes management, foot wound, and upcoming tests. The doctor referred her to surgery and outlined care instructions.

proposed_actions.title: Schedule Surgery Appointment
proposed_actions.description: Get an appointment at the county hospital outpatient clinic
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: I will refer you to surgery, to the outpatient clinic of the county hospital. Try to get an appointment during the next week.

proposed_actions.title: Prepare Weekly Medication Box
proposed_actions.description: Ana to prepare a weekly medication box for Mrs. Georgescu
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: Ana, please prepare it for the whole week on Sunday evening.

proposed_actions.title: Buy Medication from Pharmacy
proposed_actions.description: Buy the weekly medication box from the pharmacy
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: I will buy it from the pharmacy today.

proposed_actions.title: Schedule Lab Tests
proposed_actions.description: Schedule hemoglobin A1c and urine tests at the lab
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: Do those at the lab by Friday. We'll do them on Thursday, since I'm free.

proposed_actions.title: Arrange Community Assistant Visit
proposed_actions.description: Community assistant to visit Mrs. Georgescu on Monday afternoon
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: I will inform the community assistant, Mrs. Ioana, to visit you on Monday afternoon.

proposed_actions.title: Schedule Follow-Up Appointment
proposed_actions.description: Schedule follow-up appointment on November 20th at 11
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: Come back then on November 20th at 11, with the results and with the medical letter from the surgeon.

decisions: Referral to surgery for the foot wound
risks: Risk of fever or foot swelling requiring immediate attention
Risk of forgetting medication leading to high blood sugar
follow_up_questions: Is there a specific time the community assistant should arrive?
